why: One matching row and one NULL eventdate, over a one-minute window so the NULL-$1 binding stays cheap.

CountAlertReportBy#0 (datetime).note: `ts` comes from generate_series on the PRESERVED side of the RIGHT OUTER JOIN and is never NULL, so the only route to a NULL is DATE_TRUNC(NULL, ts). The $2/$3 corners — which sqlc's own IR declares nullable — return zero rows and cannot witness. So the witness binds NULL to $1, the one parameter sqlc declares NOT NULL; the claim itself is T2's TypeCast branch.
